guide: Open Start and type your center name, your fees, your discount limit, the staff pay you plan and the date of the next fee rise in the yellow cells.
Check Rates and Fees. They hold the weekly rate of every room and schedule and the registration, supply, late pickup and drop-in fees that the invoices use.
Keep Families and Children up to date: billing cycle, government share, room, schedule, days, start and end dates and discount.
Open Weekly Invoice Run on Monday and Monthly Invoice Run before the 1st: tuition, discounts, extras and the amount for every family fill in.
Write each issued invoice in Invoices. The amount, parent due, days late and message fields fill in by themselves.
Run the Invoice Check Tool to see which invoices differ from booked days times the rate, and open the largest differences first.
Record late pickups in Late Fees and drop-in days in Drop-in Days; Repeat-Late Families shows who collects late again and again.
Record each deposit in Deposits and match the ledger to your account at every month end with the Deposit and Registration Ledger.
Use New Starters Fees and the Mid-Month Start Proration for every new child: registration, supply fee, deposit and first invoice.
Plan a rise in Fee Rise Planner and Fee Rise Scenarios, then use the Fee Rise Notice Calculator for the latest day to send the notice.
Fill Statements each year and send each family a yearly payment statement.
Use the 18 calculators for billing decisions, print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Billing Dashboard and the charts every week: billed revenue, discounts, extras, late fees, deposits and the staff cost share.

listing.title: Childcare Center Tuition, Fees and Invoices Excel Template: Weekly and Monthly Invoices, Rates, Deposits, Late Pickup Fees
listing.headline: Create the right invoice for every family and keep every fee in view
listing.description:
Run the billing side of a home daycare or childcare center in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-director and an assistant director who create weekly and monthly invoices, set the rates by room and schedule, give sibling and staff discounts and keep deposits and fees in order. Rates holds the weekly, monthly, daily and hourly rate of every room and schedule against last year. Invoices holds each invoice with tuition, discount, registration, supply fee, camp fee, drop-in days, late fees and the part paid by a government childcare payment. Weekly Invoice Run and Monthly Invoice Run work out the next invoice of every family, and Invoice Check compares each invoice with the children booked times the rate.

Late Fees shows every late pickup with the fee, the waiver and the overtime cost of the staff who stayed. Deposits tracks each deposit (a payment held to keep a place, applied to the last invoice), Statements prepares the yearly payment statement of each family, and Fee Rise Scenarios shows what a rise does to your staff cost share after leavers. Discounted Children, Drop-in Days, Revenue by Room, Invoice Status by Month and Closures round out the sheets.

18 calculators cover the invoice builder, the invoice check, a sibling discount tester, the fee-rise planner, the late pickup fee, the deposit ledger, yearly statements, weekly or monthly billing, drop-in day price, camp fee against tuition, discount cost, the notice calculator, rate history, fee checks, mid-month proration, closure day credit, hourly rates and the invoice run. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to families, the assistant director, the owner-director and the accountant.

This is part four of the Home Daycare and Childcare Center suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Children appear by name, room and dates only. It helps you keep track of your billing and does not promise results. Check your local rules for fees, notice, records and tax; confirm tax questions with your adviser.

competitors.lacks: list amounts but know nothing of rooms, schedules, siblings, drop-in days, late pickup fees or a government share on the invoice
charge every month for billing you cannot see into and cannot test a fee rise, a discount rule or a closure credit before you use it
give a rate list but no invoice check, no deposit ledger and no yearly statements for parents
show one weekly price and never the monthly, daily and hourly rates, the sibling rate or the rise against last year
record payments but never show deposits held, late fees against overtime or discounts as a share of tuition

documents.title: Late pickup fee policy
paragraphs: Policy of {set:company}, dated {today}. Fee: {col:fees.fee}. Amount: {col:fees.amount}. Rule: {col:fees.rule}.

A fee for collecting a child after closing time plus a grace of {set:late_grace_min} minutes is charged for every late minute at {set:late_fee_per_min}. The fee covers the staff who stay with your child.
The fee is added to the next invoice. The owner-director may waive a fee for a real emergency. Please call us as soon as you know you will be late.
Check your local rules and your contract terms about fees and notice.

documents.title: Sibling and staff discount policy
paragraphs: Policy of {set:company}, dated {today}. Rule: {col:discount_rules.rule}. Share: {col:discount_rules.share}. Yearly cost to the center: {col:discount_rules.yearly_cost}.

A sibling discount is a lower fee for a second child in the same family: {set:sibling_pct} of tuition. A staff discount for the child of a staff member is {set:staff_pct}. Only one discount applies to a child.
Discounts start on the first day of the month after they are agreed and apply to tuition, not to registration, supply or late fees.
The center keeps total discounts under {set:discount_limit} of tuition. Check the contract terms for the details.

paragraphs: Yearly payment statement of {set:company}, dated {today}. Family: {col:statements.family}. Year: {col:statements.year}.

Paid by the family: {col:statements.parent_paid}. Paid by a government childcare payment: {col:statements.government_paid}. Total paid for childcare: {col:statements.total_paid}. Number of payments: {col:statements.payments}.
Amounts are tuition and fees before any tax and cover childcare only. Deposits are not included.
This statement is sample wording to help you keep track of your costs. Please confirm with your adviser how to use it.

Weekly invoices are issued on Monday and are due {set:weekly_due_days} days later on Friday. Monthly invoices are issued on the 1st and are due {set:invoice_days} days later. Next invoice: {col:families.next_invoice}.
A fee rise needs {set:notice_days} days of written notice. Next closure day: {col:families.next_closure}. Closure days follow the rule in your contract terms.
